text:
maria: OK folks, new thread to capture the acceptance/playbook for routing lanes, tenancy isolation, and customer-priority asks for the long-term roadmap. Keep notes short.
kevin: Suggest we split acceptance into three axes: perf (p99), cost delta, and operational blast radius. Each lane should have numeric gates.
sanjay: Agree. Quick draft gates:
- perf: p99 <= 130ms for fast lane, <= 260ms for balanced, <= 600ms for cost lane
- cost: documented infra multiplier vs baseline (shared = 1.0)
- ops: rollback age / MTTR target < 20m for critical lanes
lisa: Sales/SE input: top enterprise asks this quarter: EU residency, VPC peering, dedicated model hosting, and audit logs. They want clear acceptance criteria before contract reviews.
noah: From routing/runtime: need a policy that supports region selectors and fallback chains. Example snippet:```policy {
route: "fast-lane"
slo: "p99<130ms"
fallbacks: ["balanced-lane","cost-lane"]
canary: {pct: 3, dur: "10m"}
}```
emma: Ops telemetry: propose two signals for lane health: tail-latency-delta (10m window) and kv-cache-hit-stability (percentage churn). Add an isolation_score combining them + error-rate.
sasha: On migrations: call out an "erosion window" where both source and dest run concurrently for prefill; estimate 6-24h depending on working set. Need a billing policy for that window.
maria: Good points. I want these deliverables for the PRD: 1) SLA/acceptance matrix (kevin), 2) cost multipliers + billing treatment for erosion (sanjay + sasha), 3) policy DSL RFC (noah), 4) telemetry + isolation_score spec (emma), 5) customer ask mapping (lisa).
kevin: I'll produce an SLA matrix with perf tests and synthetic tail harness by Tue. Need eng-runtime to feed capacity numbers.
sanjay: I'll model cost bands for small/medium/large model families and include erosion window cost. Expect numbers by Thu.
lisa: I'll collect top 6 enterprise asks and the exact language they need for contracts. Also confirm residency vs dedicated requirements.
noah: I'll draft DSL RFC with multi-region failover + versioned-model fallback examples. Also include how to express "soft-evict" policies.
emma: I'll add a dashboard mock for isolation_score and propose thresholds for recommendations. Want to run it against 5 pilot tenants.
sasha: Ops will write the migration runbook and propose billing rules for concurrent warmup. Also will simulate warmups with traffic-replays.
maria: Launch criteria proposal (quick): a) SLA matrix validated end-to-end, b) policy DSL implemented in staging, c) isolation_score available for pilots, d) migration automation + billing rules, e) customer acceptance language drafted. Anything missing?\eke vin: add e2e chaos test covering region pair failover and model fallback.
sanjay: add ops headcount/maintenance estimate per isolation mode into PRD.
lisa: request: include a one-page customer checklist we can give to sales.
maria: OK adding those. Calendar: sync Fri 11am to review the PRD draft and pilot tenant list.
calendarbot: meeting created: "Lane acceptance & pilot review" Fri 11:00 Zoom link posted.
kevin: :thumbsup:
lisa: tagging SEs on the customer checklist doc once it's ready.
noah: dropped a gist with DSL examples and failover diagrams: https://gist.github.com/abc123
emma: will start prototype dashboard this week and share screenshots before Fri.
sasha: Ops will run a dry-run migration on staging Wednesday night.
maria: Thanks team. I'll create the PRD repo and share link here before EOD. Ping me for clarifications.
